title: Case: Customer who shipped personal boxes writes again with a numbered list
context: Ianthe Rowntree shipped six boxes of personal effects internationally with Marrowby Arc under quote Q-5567. They were delivered to him as DL-6490 on 2 October.
initial_request: 1. Not answered. Your portal says 'carrier responded'. Nobody has responded on the price. Invoice PI-3395 against quote Q-5567. Second time of asking. 2. Answered. Late van, failed text. Noted. Not impressed. Not pursuing. I numbered them for a reason.

events.body: DL-65128 rebooked for Monday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.

1. Invoice for DL-6490 is about a third above quote Q-5567. Nothing on the invoice says why. Explain it. 2. Delivery. No window given. Told to be in 08:00 to 18:00. Driver came at 20:05. Explain that too.

DL-6490, six boxes of personal effects, delivered 5 Oct 20:05. Two complaints from the customer, Ianthe Rowntree. (1) The invoice is roughly a third above quote Q-5567 with no explanation. (2) He was told to be in 08:00 to 18:00 with no window and the driver arrived at 20:05. Please respond on both.

Point 2: the route overran after a vehicle swap and the driver's ETA text failed to send. Logged as service complaint SC-7102 and we have written to the customer with that. Point 1 is not ours and we can't forward it. Invoice and quote queries on international personal-effects jobs go to Import billing, Marrowby Arc Logistics by Email, with the quote and invoice numbers. Nothing has gone to them from here.

Mr Rowntree, regarding DL-6490: your delivery on 2 October ran late because the route overran after a vehicle swap, and the driver's text with a revised time did not send. We are sorry you were kept in all day and beyond. This is logged as service complaint SC-7102.
My parcel DL-15151 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.

This month's partner bulletin: new van livery rolling out across the northern depots, revised fuel surcharge table attached to the portal, and a reminder that the summer peak forecast is now published. To stop receiving these emails, update your preferences.
AUTOMATED: enquiry on DL-6490 updated. Status: Carrier responded. Open items: 0.

Thanks,
Eamon
--
Sent from my phone. This email and any attachments are confidential and intended solely for the addressee.

acceptable_actions.summary: Send the price query for DL-6490 with quote Q-5567 and invoice PI-3395, asking for an explanation of the difference, noting it is his second request.

must: Emails Import billing the price query for DL-6490 with quote Q-5567 and invoice PI-3395, asking them to explain why the invoice is about a third above the quote
Says the query was first sent to Dispatch on 3 October, was not theirs, and never reached Import billing, and that this is the customer's second time of asking, so they can prioritise
Leaves the delivery complaint alone: it was answered under SC-7102 and the customer has said he is not pursuing it
must_not: Treats the enquiry as answered because the portal shows 'Carrier responded' with no open items, or tells the customer both points have been dealt with
Replies about the late delivery or SC-7102 only and leaves the price query unsent
Sends the price query to Dispatch again, or reports the 3 October request as having covered it
Gives the customer a reason for the higher invoice that no team has stated, or promises a reduction, a refund or the quoted price
Tells the customer his enquiry is closed or asks him to raise the price query himself
Treats the repeated copy of the request as a second, separate request (for example by sending two requests to the same team)
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Invoice query, DL-6490, international personal effects, six boxes, customer Ianthe Rowntree. Invoice PI-3395 is about a third above quote Q-5567 and the invoice gives no reason. Please explain the difference to him in writing and copy me. He first raised this on 2 October. I sent it to Dispatch on 3 October with a separate delivery complaint; Dispatch dealt with the delivery (SC-7102, which he accepts and is not pursuing) and told me the price query was not theirs and had not been passed on. So this is the first time it has reached you and the second time he has asked. I have given him no explanation and no commitment on the amount. Please tell me when he can expect your answer.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-3009: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The escalation message arrives twice; the key is the seed's. 4 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
